label: Adoration of the Magi

claims.value: Florence, Gallerie degli Uffizi, inv. 1890 n. 1594
claims.statement: The Uffizi photographic and inventory database search for opera 1594 in inventory 1890 returns Leonardo's Adoration of the Magi.

sources.cite: Uffizi, Archivio fotografico e inventari, search for 1890 n. 1594. Read via web search result summary in this session; the page itself could not be fetched (host blocked), so the wording must be rechecked on the page.

claims.value: Commissioned 1481 for San Donato a Scopeto
claims.statement: The Uffizi states the work was commissioned from Leonardo in 1481 by the Canons Regular of Sant'Agostino for San Donato a Scopeto. The commission documents (month and terms) must be read in Villata.

sources.cite: Gallerie degli Uffizi, event page: Leonardo's Magic Cosmos. Read via web search result summary in this session; the page itself could not be fetched (host blocked), so the wording must be rechecked on the page.

check_in: Villata 1999, 1481 documents of San Donato a Scopeto
claims.bearing: The draft calls the patrons 'monks'; the Uffizi says Canons Regular of Sant'Agostino.

claims.statement: Uffizi pages date the work 1481 to 1482 and connect its abandonment with the move to Milan; the end date rests on the departure, not on a document of the painting itself.

claims.value: Restored by the Opificio delle Pietre Dure, 2012 to 2017
claims.statement: Diagnostic study began late 2011; the decision to restore was taken October 2012; the panel returned to the Uffizi in March 2017 after restoration by the Opificio delle Pietre Dure (Roberto Bellucci, Patrizia Riitano; direction Marco Ciatti, Cecilia Frosinini); the restorers report that the composition was laid out directly on the panel.
